content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table : 3 x Polonium-210 Nugget, 3 x [[gv:nugget_beryllium|Beryllium Nugget]].
- Crafting table (x2) : [[Polonium-210|Polonium-210 Billet]], [[gv:billet_beryllium|Beryllium Billet]].
- Crafting table (x6) : 3 x [[Polonium-210|Polonium-210 Billet]], 3 x [[gv:billet_beryllium|Beryllium Billet]].

Used to make :
[[gv:pile_rod_mk2_po210be|Chicago Pile Po210Be Neutron source]], [[gv:rbmk_fuel_po210be|Po210Be RBMK Neutron Source]].

Obtention :

- Établi (x6) : 3 x [[Polonium-210|Billet de polonium-210]], 3 x [[gv:billet_beryllium|Billet de béryllium]].
